**Why the command reveals them:**
By default, `fd` automatically searches for and parses `.gitignore`, `.ignore`, `.fdignore`, and global gitignore configurations, pruning matching files and directories during traversal. The `-I` (`--no-ignore`) flag disables this filter, instructing `fd`'s directory walker to bypass all ignore rules and include ignored files and build artifacts (such as `target/`) in the search results.
